title: 3.2 Probability II: combined events and tree diagrams

q.Q2: Q2. A die is rolled twice. Find the probability of getting two sixes.
q.Q3: Q3. Each seed in the hook germinates with probability 0.9, independently. Find the probability that at least one of two seeds germinates.

q.Q4: Q4. The probability that a matatu is late is 0.3. On two days, find the probability that it is late on exactly one day.

q.Q5: Q5. A box has 4 good and 2 faulty bulbs. Two are taken without replacement. Find the probability that both are faulty.
q.Q6: Q6. For the same box, find the probability that exactly one bulb is faulty.

q.Q7: Q7. The probabilities that Amina passes Maths, English and Biology are 0.8, 0.9 and 0.7, independently. Find the probability she passes all three, and that she fails all three.
